subject: general
question: The Windvane instrument measures the ______.
solution:
The correct answer is__** wind - direction.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The correct option is 4, wind direction**.
 
• **A wind vane, also known as a weather vane, is an instrument used for measuring wind direction. It consists of a rotating arrow or pointer, which aligns itself with the direction of the wind.**
 
• Wind direction is an important parameter in weather forecasting, aviation, and marine navigation.
 
• It helps in predicting the movement of weather systems, determining the flight path of aircraft, and plotting the course of ships.
 
• Relative humidity is a measure of the amount of moisture in the air compared to the maximum amount that the air could hold at a given temperature. It is measured using a hygrometer. 
 
• Temperature is a measure of the degree of hotness or coldness of an object or substance. It is measured using a thermometer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Wind velocity is the speed at which the air is moving. It is measured using an anemometer. 
 
• The wind vane and anemometer are often combined into a single instrument called a weather station or a meteorological station.
